_meta.note: Identity evidence, owner verification and production activation are three separate things. _meta.skuEvidence: The app catalog ships no SKU. The 2026-07-30 discovery file supplies a QUEEN SKU per product as a LEAD; where that exact SKU is still present in the current snapshot it is recorded as a direct identity link. Historical prices are never reused and no other size's SKU is ever inferred.
